title: Verify fee/discount history stays visible when amounts are hidden by See Financial Data being off
custom_preconds:
1. A WO has fee/discount history entries.
  2. A ZZAUTOTEST role is assigned to Tech with Work Orders: Create and Edit ON but See Financial Data OFF (exact-user-match).
custom_steps:
1. As a role without See Financial Data, open the work order and the 'Work Order Log'.
  2. Look for the fee/discount entries.
custom_expected:
1. Fee/discount dollar amounts are hidden on the normal screens (See Financial Data off).
  2. The fee/discount history entries still show in the Work Order Log (the log shows the set rate, not a resolved total, so See Financial Data does not gate it).
